Direct experience on the Lake is brought by Angelo, an Airbnb Superhost since 2017, who looks after hospitality and the guest relationship. Alongside him, one partner handles admin, IT, dynamic pricing and channel integration, and a third partner lives in Como and curates the local network — restaurants, transfers, experiences that make the difference in reviews.

faq.subtitle: Five clear answers about who we are, our method and the team. If you are looking for operational questions about the service, you'll find them on the Services page.

items.q: How long have you been active on the Lake Como market?
items.a: We have been hosting on Lake Como since 2017. Angelo has been an Airbnb Superhost since then, with more than 350 five-star reviews. Host Como was founded to extend that method to a wider set of properties while keeping the same level of care.

items.q: What types of properties do you manage?
items.a: We manage apartments, villas and houses across the Como area, with a particular focus on Lake Como. We work both on premium lakefront properties and on more compact homes in strategic positions, on the lake shore as well as in central Como and in the surrounding municipalities. The deciding factor isn't the size but the location, the condition of the property and the owner's alignment on the quality level required.

items.q: How do you select the properties you take on?
items.a: We start with a free on-site assessment to evaluate location, condition, amenities and earning potential. We benchmark the numbers against our local historical database. We only take on properties where we can guarantee a concrete result to the owner — if we don't see margin, we say so plainly.

We are a team of three with complementary skills. One of the founders has been an Airbnb Superhost since 2017 with more than 350 five-star reviews: he looks after guest hospitality, relationship management and quality standards in the home. A second partner handles admin, tax compliance, contracts, the technology behind dynamic pricing and the integration with OTAs. The third partner lives in Como and is an expert in the local restaurant scene and experiences: he curates the network of local partners — restaurants, private transfers, excursions, lake activities — to turn a stay into a memorable experience that drives five-star reviews.

items.q: In which languages do you communicate with guests?
items.a: Thanks to our different backgrounds we communicate directly in Italian, English, Romanian, Russian and German. We also handle conversations in Spanish, although not at native level. This widens the pool of reachable guests and reduces friction in pre-booking conversations: replying quickly in the guest's language is statistically correlated with higher conversion.

faq.subtitle: Eight operational questions on costs, channels, hospitality, compliance, reports and timing. For questions about who we are and the team, see the About page.

items.q: How much does your service cost?
items.a: We work on a percentage commission on the revenue generated, with no fixed onboarding fee. The exact model is shared in a free preliminary consultation, once we have assessed the property and its potential numbers together.

items.q: On which platforms do you list properties?
items.a: We publish properties on the primary channels Airbnb, Booking and Expedia — those that generate the highest volume of tourist bookings on Lake Como. We add long-stay secondary channels such as subito.it and other specialised portals to reach professionals, remote workers and stays longer than one month. The goal is to maximise occupancy throughout the year, not only during the summer peaks.

items.q: Do you handle cleaning, check-in and linen?
items.a: Yes. We coordinate professional cleaning crews between stays, manage self or assisted check-in with codes and multilingual video instructions, provide linen and restock courtesy amenities. The owner is never involved operationally.

items.q: Do you also handle regulatory compliance (CIR, CIN, flat-tax, tourist tax)?
items.a: Yes — we manage end-to-end compliance for short-term rentals on Lake Como: Lombardy CIR and national CIN registration, police reporting via Alloggiati Web, ISTAT, flat-tax management, collection and remittance of the tourist tax to the municipality.

items.q: Do you send me periodic reports on how my property is performing?
items.a: Yes. Every month you get a dedicated email summary with bookings, occupancy, average rate, net revenue and the compliance handled in the period. You also have 24/7 access to a personal dashboard with all the numbers in real time and tracked payouts.

items.q: How do you handle complaints and critical situations with guests?
items.a: 24/7 availability throughout the entire stay. Most issues are resolved in minutes: access codes, directions, amenities. For technical emergencies we have a network of plumbers, electricians and maintenance specialists on the Lake, ready to step in the same day. The owner always receives a post-event recap.

items.q: What happens if my home stays vacant?
items.a: The percentage-commission model aligns our incentives with yours: if we don't generate revenue for the owner, we don't generate revenue for ourselves. That's why we invest constantly in revenue management and diversify channels — primary tourist channels at peak, long-stay during low season — to avoid prolonged vacancy.

items.q: How quickly do you launch a new property?
items.a:
It depends on the starting point. If the listing already exists on Airbnb, Booking or other channels and we need to boost its visibility, from signing the mandate to launch it takes about 15 days: professional photo shoot, multilingual copy rewrite, dynamic pricing setup, channel synchronisation and listing optimisation.

If the property is not yet on the market and has to be set up from scratch, on top of our operational work we have to factor in the regulatory timelines: SCIA / SUAP filing with the Como municipality and the Lombardy CIR + national CIN application. These filings depend on public-administration response times and in the worst case can take up to 2 months. In this scenario we typically go live with publication 6-8 weeks from signing.
